# SNF-preprocessing

# The sequence below achieves the desired result:

data_list <- generate_data_list(mtbi_loc = as_mtbi_loc,
                                mtbi_mem_daze = as_mtbi_mem_daze)


# List of the subjects in each input type
subjects <- lapply(data_list, function(x) x[[1]]$"subjectkey")


# Shared subjects in each input type
a <- Reduce(intersect, subjects)


just_dfs <- lapply(data_list, function(x) x[[1]])


filtered_dfs <-
    lapply(just_dfs, function(x) dplyr::filter(x, subjectkey %in% a))


for (i in seq_along(data_list)) {
    data_list[[i]][[1]] <- filtered_dfs[[i]]
}
